name: Godot 4 Health & Damage Component
description: Signal-driven Godot 4 GDScript HealthComponent node with invulnerability frames, armor mitigation, healing caps, defeat signals, and HUD bar binding.

preview.caption: Godot 4 Node component — attach HealthComponent as a child of any CharacterBody2D/3D and connect signals to HealthBarHUD.
architecture: Armor mitigation + i-frame guard -> clamp(hp, 0, max_hp)
preview.projectRef: Copy scripts into res://components/combat/ in any Godot 4 project.

install: Copy health_component.gd and health_bar_hud.gd into res://components/combat/ in your Godot 4 project.
usage: Add HealthComponent as a child node of your player or enemy scene, configure max_health and armor_reduction, and bind HealthBarHUD.health_component in the Inspector.

verification.label: Godot 4 Headless Verified
verification.details: Executed in Godot 4 headless SceneTree via scripts/validate-components.mjs (armor mitigation, minimum damage floor, i-frame blocking, heal cap, defeated signal, and HealthBarHUD label sync).
